before.name: c. 2879 BC: Rise of the Xích Quỷ Kingdom and the Hồng Bàng dynasty in northern Viet Nam and southern China

after.name: Traditional 2879 BC date for legendary Hồng Bàng origin; not a verified founding

r2SourceEvidence.review_note: The 29th-century overview states a founding in 2879 BCE, but linked articles identify the Hồng Bàng origin and Kinh Dương Vương as legendary and attribute this year to a 15th-century Vietnamese chronicle. The retained -2879 reference is the date assigned in later tradition, not evidence of a verified founding, state, ruler, border or a tradition arising that year. No precise biography, action or political effect is established. The two indexed notes may represent the same traditional claim; both IDs and map references are retained pending a separate semantic and saved-state review. Coordinates and radius are inherited gameplay references, not evidence that the legendary event occurred there.
r2SourceEvidence.date_precision: A date in later tradition, not an archaeologically verified year or event.
r2SourceEvidence.location_precision: Inherited game reference; not proof of historical event location or political territory.
